title: Name every feature slug verb-object

facts.note: subject_kind feature: the plan contains feature artifacts with URN feature:<wagon>:<name>, whether new, renamed or unchanged
validator runs at CONFIRM over all feature slugs and is confirm-blocking; phase is not yet observable from the harness

fires: Planner adds a feature whose URN is feature:<wagon>:<name>
Planner renames an existing feature slug
CONFIRM validation runs over a plan containing features, including unchanged slugs whose feature body alone was edited
doesNotFire: Plan contains no feature URNs (only wagons, WMBTs or acceptances)
Naming a wagon, WMBT or acceptance rather than a feature slug

given: A plan contains features with URN feature:<wagon>:<name> (new, renamed or unchanged)
when: The planner names a feature slug (3rd URN segment) or the plan reaches CONFIRM
then: Every feature slug is verb-object: kebab-case, at least two tokens, leading token a verb from the convention verb lexicon, no connective tokens.
prefer: Leading verb from the feature verb-selection lexicon (conventions:planner:feature#/artifact_seeds/verb_selection)
Slugs like make-choice, authenticate-user, route-request, preview-changes, respond-event
List a needed brand/proper-noun slug in feature.convention.yaml verb_object_enforcement.brand_exceptions
avoid: Connective slugs like respond-and-preview, route-to-mode (split or rename to one verb-object)
Single-token slugs or a non-lexicon first token
Implicit brand/proper-noun exceptions — unlisted is a violation
unless: Slug is a brand/proper-noun listed in feature.convention.yaml verb_object_enforcement.brand_exceptions
why: A verb-object slug names the single behaviour a feature delivers, keeping features atomic and names consistent; connectives signal bundled behaviours.
evidence: On failure the validator reports feature_urn and reason
verifier_detail: Family format, template naming_pattern, variant planner_feature_name_is_verb_object; subject_kind feature

Parse the 3rd segment of feature:<wagon>:<name> for every feature in the plan (not only changed ones); require kebab-case, >=2 tokens, token[0] in verb lexicon from conventions:planner:feature#/artifact_seeds/verb_selection, no connective tokens (e.g. and, to)
Exempt only slugs listed in feature.convention.yaml verb_object_enforcement.brand_exceptions
Phase CONFIRM, enforcement confirm-blocking; failure_evidence: feature_urn, reason
Known-good fixtures: make-choice, authenticate-user, route-request, preview-changes, respond-event; known-bad: respond-and-preview, route-to-mode
audit: term_id feature_verb_object: the verb-object naming rule for a feature slug
Source name: Feature name is verb-object
